description: Provider + hook, local-only dismiss/snooze store, action-descriptor dispatcher, and app-shell wiring in App.tsx — the non-UI integration layer that mirrors the command palette and feeds the panel/trigger. Depends on FEAT-001 (engine, types, visible, extracted resolveReminderBaseTarget).
steps: Create src/components/assistant/AssistantContext.tsx mirroring src/components/command-palette/CommandPaletteContext.tsx exactly in shape: AssistantProvider + useAssistantContext exposing { isOpen, open, close, toggle }.

Create src/components/assistant/dismissStore.ts: persist DismissRecord { dismissed: string[]; snoozedUntil: Record<string, number> } to localStorage key 'assistant-dismissals' with try/catch in-memory fallback (mirror Navigation's storage handling). Methods: dismiss(id), snooze(id, now) (24h = now + 24*60*60*1000), pruneDismissed(activeIds:Set<string>) (drop dismissed ids not in activeIds), and a read accessor returning the current DismissRecord. No network, ever.

Create src/components/assistant/useAssistantActions.ts exposing dispatchAction(action:SuggestionAction): switch on kind — 'navigate' calls the injected navigate(page, subTab); 'roll' resolves baseTarget via resolveReminderBaseTarget (FEAT-001) and sets a NEW shell reminder-roll state carrying difficulty; default is a compile-time `never` exhaustiveness assertion + console.warn no-op. It must never call an advance/apply/mutation handler.

Wire src/App.tsx: wrap AppContent with <AssistantProvider> beside <CommandPaletteProvider> (inside ErrorBoundary). In AppWithCharacter: memoize assistantContext={inCombat:character.combatState.inCombat}; memoize rawSuggestions from deterministicSuggestionSource.getSuggestions(character, assistantContext) using the Array.isArray(r)?r:[] sync-narrowing; memoize suggestions=visibleSuggestions(rawSuggestions, dismissState, Date.now()); add a useEffect keyed on rawSuggestions that calls dismissStore.pruneDismissed(new Set(rawSuggestions.map(s=>s.id))) (write in effect, never in render). Add a NEW reminder-roll state { name, baseTarget, difficulty } and render a second RollDialog with defaultDifficulty={reminderRollState.difficulty}; leave the existing quick-roll { name, baseTarget } state and its RollDialog untouched. Thread suggestions.length + open() into Navigation props (consumed by the trigger in FEAT-003) and render a placeholder-free <AssistantPanel suggestions={suggestions} onAction={dispatchAction} onDismiss onSnooze /> mount point (AssistantPanel component arrives in FEAT-003; until then wire the data/handlers so the shell type-checks — if FEAT-003 has not landed, a minimal internal panel stub that renders the mount is acceptable as long as it is replaced by FEAT-003).
acceptance_criteria: AssistantProvider/useAssistantContext expose isOpen/open/close/toggle and throw when used outside the provider, mirroring the command palette.

dismissStore persists to localStorage key 'assistant-dismissals', snoozes for 24h, prunes dismissed ids absent from activeIds, and falls back to in-memory state when localStorage throws — with no network call (asserted with stubbed/throwing storage).

dispatchAction routes navigate -> injected navigate(page,subTab) and roll -> resolved baseTarget + descriptor difficulty into the new reminder-roll state; it calls no advance/apply/mutation handler (asserted).

App.tsx derives rawSuggestions/suggestions from the single engine call, runs the prune in an effect (not render), honours the sync-narrowing, keeps the quick-roll state unchanged, and passes count+open into Navigation; the second RollDialog honours defaultDifficulty.
The pre-existing test suite passes unchanged.
verification: npx eslint . (0 errors, no new warnings; the set-state-in-effect disable only if a genuine external-sync write is needed)
findings:
IMPLEMENTED on current branch (no worktree). All four gates clean: `npx tsc --build --force --noEmit` 0 errors; `npm run build` succeeds; `vitest --run` 484 files / 5310 tests pass (pre-existing suite unchanged — FEAT-001 was 482/5299; +2 files / +11 tests from this FEAT); `npx eslint .` 0 errors + 3 PRE-EXISTING react-refresh/only-export-components warnings ONLY (CommandPaletteContext.tsx, CombatPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx) — NO new warnings. New tests: src/components/assistant/__tests__/dismissStore.test.ts (7) + useAssistantActions.test.tsx (4).

FILES CREATED:
- src/components/assistant/AssistantContext.tsx — exports ONLY the `AssistantProvider` component (plus a type-only re-export of AssistantContextValue).
- src/components/assistant/assistantContextValue.ts — NEW sibling module holding the React context object, the `useAssistantContext()` hook, and the `AssistantContextValue` interface { isOpen, open, close, toggle }. WHY SPLIT (important for FEAT-003): keeping both the Provider component AND the hook in the .tsx triggers a NEW react-refresh/only-export-components warning (same as CommandPaletteContext.tsx), which the no-new-warnings gate forbids; re-exporting the hook as a value from the .tsx ALSO warns. So the hook+context+type live in assistantContextValue.ts and the .tsx exports only the component. IMPORT THE HOOK FROM './assistantContextValue' (App.tsx and AssistantPanel.tsx already do), NOT from './AssistantContext'. The hook still throws 'useAssistantContext must be used within an AssistantProvider' outside the provider.
- src/components/assistant/dismissStore.ts — exports `dismissStore` { read(), dismiss(id), snooze(id, now), pruneDismissed(activeIds:Set<string>) } plus consts `DISMISS_STORAGE_KEY='assistant-dismissals'` and `SNOOZE_DURATION_MS=24*60*60*1000`, and type alias `DismissRecord = DismissState` (reusing src/logic/assistant/visible.ts's DismissState so store and pure filter share one shape). localStorage with try/catch in-memory fallback; NO network. Each mutator RETURNS the resulting record (so the shell can mirror it into React state); pruneDismissed skips a redundant write when nothing changes and also prunes orphaned snoozedUntil entries.
- src/components/assistant/useAssistantActions.ts — exports `useAssistantActions({ character, navigate, openReminderRoll })` returning `dispatchAction(action:SuggestionAction)`, and type `ReminderRollState { name; baseTarget; difficulty }`. navigate -> navigate(page, subTab); roll -> resolveReminderBaseTarget(character, test.def) then openReminderRoll({name:test.rollName, baseTarget, difficulty:test.difficulty}); default -> `never` exhaustiveness + console.warn no-op. Calls NO advance/apply/mutation handler (asserted).
- src/components/assistant/AssistantPanel.tsx — TEMPORARY SHELL STUB (flagged in-file) for FEAT-003 TO REPLACE. Props: `AssistantPanelProps { suggestions: Suggestion[]; onAction: (action: SuggestionAction) => void; onDismiss: (id: string) => void; onSnooze: (id: string) => void }`. Renders a minimal createPortal(document.body) overlay gated on useAssistantContext().isOpen (closed by default => no layout footprint), listing each suggestion's title/rationale with primary-action, optional secondary-action (s.secondaryAction), Dismiss and Snooze buttons. FEAT-003 owns the real drawer/bottom-sheet, focus trap, SuggestionItem rows, citation + totals Tooltip, and AssistantPanel.test.tsx — KEEP the same AssistantPanelProps shape so the App.tsx mount point is unchanged.

STUB LEFT AT SHELL: YES — AssistantPanel.tsx is the stub FEAT-003 must replace. The App.tsx mount is already live: `<AssistantPanel suggestions={suggestions} onAction={dispatchAction} onDismiss={handleDismissSuggestion} onSnooze={handleSnoozeSuggestion} />` rendered inside AppWithCharacter's returned fragment (after the two RollDialogs).

NAVIGATION WIRING FOR THE FEAT-003 TRIGGER: added TWO optional props to src/components/layout/Navigation.tsx's NavigationProps — `assistantCount?: number` and `onOpenAssistant?: () => void`. App passes `assistantCount={suggestions.length}` (already dismiss/snooze-filtered so badge==panel) and `onOpenAssistant={openAssistant}` (openAssistant = useAssistantContext().open from the shell, which sits inside AssistantProvider). They are declared in the interface but NOT yet destructured/rendered in Navigation — FEAT-003 renders <AssistantTrigger> beside the Search/Shortcuts buttons (desktop expanded + collapsed + mobile scroll row) consuming these two props and honouring the onTouchEnd preventDefault pattern. badgeItems / nav-item badges were left unchanged.

APP.TSX SHELL WIRING (AppWithCharacter): <AssistantProvider> wraps <AppContent/> beside <CommandPaletteProvider> inside ErrorBoundary. Derived once each: assistantContext=useMemo({inCombat:character.combatState.inCombat}); rawSuggestions=useMemo(deterministicSuggestionSource.getSuggestions(character,assistantContext)) narrowed via Array.isArray(r)?r:[]; suggestions=useMemo(visibleSuggestions(rawSuggestions, dismissState, assistantNow)). Prune effect keyed on [rawSuggestions] calls dismissStore.pruneDismissed(new Set(rawSuggestions.map(s=>s.id))) and syncs the result into React state — this is the ONLY `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` added (on setDismissState; the sanctioned external-system-sync pattern). The quick-roll { name, baseTarget } state + its RollDialog are UNCHANGED; a NEW `reminderRollState {name,baseTarget,difficulty}` (+ reminderRollResult) drives a SECOND RollDialog with `defaultDifficulty={reminderRollState.difficulty}` and a RollResultDisplay.

PURITY/LINT NOTE for FEAT-003: `Date.now()` must NOT be called during render (react-hooks/purity is an ERROR here). The shell holds `assistantNow` in state (lazy init `useState(()=>Date.now())`), refreshed in the prune effect and in handleSnoozeSuggestion; visibleSuggestions is fed that state value, never a render-time Date.now(). If FEAT-003 needs 'now' in a component, follow the same pattern (lazy state / event handler), not a render-time clock read.

OQ-5 (snooze duration/key): implemented the design-stated 24h fixed duration and 'assistant-dismissals' key exactly as design.md §Dismiss/snooze specifies — spec-resolved, not guessed. (design.md still lists OQ-5 as 'confirm' for the reviewer; the implementation matches its stated default, so no behaviour was invented.)
